COREMERCH offers a solution that enables you to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products using cryptocurrency. This guide will walk you through leveraging our infrastructure to deploy your own digital store, ensuring you maintain [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers|The Complete]] ownership and control over your business without incurring the high fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms often impose significant fees and restrictions that hinder creators from maximizing their profits. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can substantially cut into your revenue. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges a minimal 0.5%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings. By building your commerce stack on COREMERCH infrastructure, you circumvent platform limitations and gain complete ownership of your store and data, ensuring that you remain in control of your digital products and revenue streams.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment, gather the essential components for the setup. You will need a digital product to sell, such as an ebook, course, or software. Create a GitHub account for hosting your store, and prepare your digital files for delivery. Decide on your preferred cryptocurrency for payments and set up a NOWPayments account. Additionally, ensure you have access to Cloudflare for hosting and backend logic. With these elements in place, you will be ready to deploy your commerce infrastructure efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your selected stack. For the Sovereign Starter Stack, use GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for hosting and backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Configure the payment processing to convert prices to USD at the time of transaction. Once payments are confirmed, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to automate file delivery to your customers. This setup ensures a seamless purchasing experience while maintaining data ownership.
Save up to $921 a month by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After your stack is deployed, it’s time to go live. Share your store link with your audience and promote your products through social media or email marketing. Monitor your store for customer engagement and feedback. To process your first transaction, ensure that you have configured the NOWPayments integration correctly. Once a customer places an order, the automated delivery mechanism will send them their digital product upon payment confirmation, allowing you to focus on scaling your business rather than handling transactions manually.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is operational, consider scaling your offerings. You can expand your product range by adding more digital items or increasing your marketing efforts to reach a wider audience. Collect customer feedback to improve your offerings and enhance user experience. Take advantage of the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, to further optimize your stack and streamline your operations. With this robust infrastructure, you can effectively grow your digital business without the stress of platform restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain complete ownership of your digital products without relying on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, leveraging the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH allows you to build a fully functional digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information and to access the tools needed for your sovereign commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my digital store?

To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their platform and follow the integration guide provided by COREMERCH. You will need to configure your payment settings and connect it to your deployment for seamless cryptocurrency transactions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide audience. Popular options include Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT, ensuring you can offer flexible payment options to your customers.
Can I customize the appearance of my digital store?

Yes, you can customize your digital store's appearance by editing the HTML and CSS in your GitHub repository. This allows you to create a unique brand experience that resonates with your target audience.
Is there a limit to the number of products I can sell?
No, there is no limit to the number of products you can sell once your infrastructure is up and running. You can scale your offerings as your business grows, adding new digital products at any time.
What support options are available if I encounter issues?

COREMERCH provides 30-day support for your deployed stack. If you face any issues, reach out for assistance, or consult the documentation provided in the Sovereign Blueprint for troubleshooting guidance.
